spans.s: दत् m. (This word has no forms for the first five cases and is rarely used by itself. According to some authorities, it is not a separate word but a substitute for दंत in certain cases.) A tooth.
दत्त (I) a. (f. त्ता) 1. Given, presented; 2. made over, assigned; 3. placed, stretched fourth, (pp. of दा q.v.).

दत्त (II) m. 1. One of the twelve kinds of sons in Hindu law; (he is thus defined by Manu- माता पिता वा दद्यातां यमद्भिः पुत्रमापदि । सदृशं प्रीतिसंयुक्तं स ज्ञेयो दत्त्रिमः सुतः ix.168); 2. an affix to the names of the Vaiśyas, e.g. वसुदत्त, (शर्मा देवश्च विप्रस्य वर्मा त्राता च भूभुजः । भुतिर्दत्तश्च वैश्यस्य दासः शूद्रस्य्स् कारयेत्); 3. the name of a son of Atri and Anasūyā. (See दत्तात्रेय below).
दत्त (III) n. A gift, a donation.
दत्त (I) a. (f. त्ता) 1. Given, presented; 2. made over, assigned; 3. placed, stretched fourth, (pp. of दा q.v.).
दात a. (f. ता) 1. Divided; 2. cleaned, washed, purified.
दात a. (f. ता) 1. Divided; 2. cleaned, washed, purified.
दत्त-अनपाकर्मन्, -अप्रदानिक n. non-delivery or resumption of gifts (in law).
दत्त-अनपाकर्मन्, -अप्रदानिक n. non-delivery or resumption of gifts (in law).
दत्त-अवधान a. attentive.
दत्त-आत्रेय m. name of a sage, son of Atri and Anasūyā, considered as an incarnation of Brahman (m.), Viṣṇu and Śiva.
दत्त-आदर a. 1. showing respect, respectful; 2. treated with respect.
दत्त-शुल्का f. a bride for whom a dowry has been paid.

दत्त-हस्त a. 1. having a hand given for upport, supported by the hand, स कामरूपेश्वरदत्तहस्तः R.vii.17; (hence) 2. supported, encouraged, assisted, दैवेनेत्थं दत्तहस्तावलंबे Rat.i, or वात्या खेदं कृशांग्याः सुचिरमवयवैर्दत्तहस्ता करोति Ve.ii. (In this phrase, हस्त is rendered by some scholars by ‘writing, autograph’).
दत्तक m. An adopted son, Yaj.ii.130. See दत्त
II.1
दत्ति f. 1. Gift, donation; 2. offering, oblation, अनुगृह्णीष्व निवापदत्तिभिः R.viii.86.
दाति f. 1. Giving; 2. cutting, destroying.
दत्तेय m. A name of Indra.
दत्त्रिम m. An adopted son. See दत्त
II.1
दातृ (I) a. (f. त्री) Giving, bestowing, imparting.
दातृ (II) m. 1. A donor, a giver, Bh.V.i.66; 2. a creditor, a lender; 3. a teacher.
दातृ (I) a. (f. त्री) Giving, bestowing, imparting.
दात्यूह m. 1. The gallinule, दात्यूहैस्थिनिशस्य कोटरवति स्कंधे निलीय स्थितम् M.M.ix.; 2. the chātaka bird; 3. a water-crow; 4. a cloud. (Also दात्यौह.)
दात्र n. An instrument of cutting, a sort of sickle.
